name: Summer Program for Children
operator_name: The Eliot School of Fine & Applied Arts
description_short: A weekly arts day camp for ages 6-12 at the Eliot School Schoolhouse in Boston. Each week has a theme, and children take woodworking, fiber arts, mixed media, and Art Zone classes in half-day or full-day sessions, with lunch and play outdoors in the Schoolyard.
refund_policy_summary: 2026 policy: you must contact the Community Education Coordinator to withdraw. Full refund through May 1, 50% refund through June 5, and no refunds from June 6. A $20 processing fee applies to all refunds. Registrations made within two weeks of the start date, or after June 5, get no refund. Exceptions may be arranged for serious illness, major injury, or a death in the family.

sessions.name: Week One: Stories We Love (4 days, full day)
Week Three: Carnival of Craft (full day)
Week Six: Feast for the Imagination (full day)

warnings: The page shows only the 2026 season, which ended in August 2026. Today is 2026-10-13, and no 2027 dates, prices or registration date are posted.

Session prices are full-day rates, which require the FULLDAYFUN coupon. Half day is $325 a week ($290 in Week One). Early Drop-Off ($80, or $64 in Week One) and Extended Day ($150, or $120 in Week One) cost extra.
Financial aid funds for 2026 are fully distributed and scholarship applications are closed.
The bottom of the page has unrelated gambling spam links ('slot gacor', 'situs toto'), which suggests the site may be compromised. Check details directly with the school.
Early Drop-Off and Extended Day are limited to 15 students a week.
